capability: Check what came out, not what it claims
title: Check the work, not its label.

hook.picture: Close: a run with a bright green tag swims to a pod. The line itself is the wrong colour, and the pod answers ✕.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The report said green. The screen said otherwise.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: A gate reads only the tags. Three times, faster each time, green-tagged runs of the wrong colour pass and pods answer ✕.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: We checked what it said it was.

stakes.body: Decisions get made on green reports while customers see the broken thing, and trust in every report drops.

solution_hint: Look at what really came out.

metaphor.body: A label tag rides on each run. A gate that reads the tag passes wrong work. Turning the gate's lens onto the line itself catches it.

steps.picture: The gate's lens turns from the tag down to the line itself.
A green-tagged rust run stops at the gate. The bar drops.
steps.words: Check the thing itself, not its tag.

steps.picture: Push-in: the tag peels away, showing the line's real colour.
steps.sound: A peel, the sour tone exposed

steps.picture: A true slate run passes. The opening glows. Tick.
steps.words: The tag said one thing. The line, another.

steps.picture: Runs flow, and the gate looks at each line, not each tag.

steps.words: Read what was built, not what was planned.

real_case.claim: Two escapes came from checking the plan, not the result: 'Example declared IBM Plex, rendered Inter' and 'Built page at 1.18:1 contrast' (tokens only). Both are now checked on what renders.

honest_limit.picture: A run with a made-up source tick passes the gate that reads the line. Push in, and behind the tick there is nothing.
honest_limit.words: An invented source still looks real.

not_this.body: Checked output can still quote made-up sources.

ending_pattern.body: The same green-tagged run nears the same pod. The gate looks past the tag, the tag peels off, the line is fixed and the pod answers ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: Same close framing as bar 1: the green tag that hid the wrong line is gone.

end_belief.body: Trust what came out, not what it says.
